description: Lists software from HMRC's list of Making Tax Digital for Income Tax software that meets the needs given, in fit order (no product pays for its place). Filters: income types, how records are kept now (spreadsheets needs bridging software), a free plan, number of properties, filing the year-end tax return, other income, VAT, Welsh, and where it runs. Each product comes with its price, why it fits, what to watch out for, its HMRC listing, the vendor's website and a link to Landlord Lookout.

files_tax_return.description: true: only products that also file the year-end tax return.

free_plan.description: true: only products with a free plan that covers these needs (not free only with a business bank account).

income_types.description: Income the software must report. Leave out to search every product.

limit.description: How many products to return, 1 to 25. Default 10.

other_income.description: Whether wages, pensions, savings or dividends also go on the return. Products that cannot confirm this rank lower.

platforms.description: Where it must run. Every value given must hold.

properties.description: How many properties are let. Used to check free plan limits.

records.description: How records are kept now. spreadsheets: only products that send figures from a spreadsheet (bridging). paper_or_nothing: only products that keep the records themselves. software or left out: no filter.

vat_registered.description: true: only products that handle VAT.

welsh.description: true: only products offered in Welsh.

name: find_mtd_software
title: Find MTD software that fits
